pages.title: Filling Unit
pages.text: The Filling Unit loads powders or liquids into containers — producing capsules, canned goods, etc.$(br2)Power: 20 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 per 10 seconds$(br)Clearance: 6x4
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
